title: Performance and Concurrency Tests
summary: This module contains integration tests focused on evaluating the performance, concurrency, and context handling capabilities of the model serving system under various load conditions.

nodes.label: Multi-Model Stress Test
nodes.title: Multi-Model Stress Test
nodes.description: Tests the system's ability to handle multiple models concurrently, dynamically adjusting the number of loaded models based on available VRAM to simulate thrashing scenarios.

nodes.label: Concurrent Chat Test
nodes.title: Concurrent Chat Test
nodes.description: Evaluates the system's performance when handling multiple simultaneous chat requests to a single model, focusing on concurrency and response times.

nodes.label: Parallel Chat with History Test
nodes.title: Parallel Chat with History Test
nodes.description: Assesses the system's capacity to manage multiple parallel chat sessions, each maintaining its own conversational history, and adjusts timeouts based on GPU utilization.

nodes.label: Chat with History Test
nodes.title: Chat with History Test
nodes.description: Verifies the correct handling of conversational history in a single chat session, ensuring context is maintained across multiple turns.

nodes.label: Context Exhaustion Test
nodes.title: Context Exhaustion Test
nodes.description: Tests the model's behavior when the input context approaches or exceeds its maximum capacity, ensuring graceful handling of large prompts.

nodes.label: Long Input Context Test
nodes.title: Long Input Context Test
nodes.description: Validates the system's ability to process very long input prompts, checking for correct truncation or rejection behavior.

nodes.label: Parallel Generate with History Test
nodes.title: Parallel Generate with History Test
nodes.description: Examines the system's performance when handling multiple parallel generate requests, each with its own context continuation, and adapts timeouts based on GPU usage.

nodes.label: Generate with History Test
nodes.title: Generate with History Test
nodes.description: Confirms the proper continuation of generation context across multiple requests, specifically for the Generate API.

nodes.label: Max Queue Test
nodes.title: Max Queue Test
nodes.description: Tests the server's request queuing mechanism by simulating a high volume of concurrent embedding requests while a generate request is active, verifying queue limits and error handling.

nodes.label: Model Performance Test
nodes.title: Model Performance Test
nodes.description: Executes performance benchmarks for various models, including both Ollama engine and Llama runner chat models, to measure their speed and efficiency.

nodes.label: Library Model Performance Test
nodes.title: Library Model Performance Test
nodes.description: Runs performance benchmarks specifically for models from the library, assessing their speed and resource utilization.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.description: Handles incoming API requests for chat, generation, pulling, pushing, showing, and embedding models.

nodes.label: Model Scheduling and Caching
nodes.title: Model Scheduling and Caching
nodes.description: Manages the loading, unloading, and caching of models to optimize resource utilization and response times.

groups.label: Concurrency Tests
groups.title: Concurrency Test Suite
groups.description: Tests designed to evaluate the system's ability to handle multiple simultaneous requests and models.

groups.label: Context Handling Tests
groups.title: Context Handling Test Suite
groups.description: Tests focused on verifying the correct management and limits of conversational and generation context.

groups.label: Queue and Resource Tests
groups.title: Queue and Resource Management Tests
groups.description: Tests that examine the server's request queuing and resource allocation under heavy load.

groups.label: Performance Benchmarks
groups.title: Performance Benchmark Suite
groups.description: Tests designed to measure and evaluate the raw performance of various models and the overall system.
